summary: Frontend-only E2E test of SB Drive Access (Phase 1) booking flow with user paul.vendeur. All happy-path steps, WCAG toggles, wheelchair-need vehicle filtering, and both entry points (UserHome card + Taxi Hub grid card) work correctly.

issues: Fare displayed in Step 3 (e.g. 15.99 €) is rounded to integer in confirmation (16 €) without decimals — inconsistent display between estimate and confirmed booking. Minor cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: SbAccessPage.js (394 lines) — file is approaching size limit; consider extracting each Step component (StepNeeds, StepAssistance, StepTrip, StepVehicle, StepConfirmation) into separate components under /pages/user/sb_access/.
GooglePlacesInput uses deprecated google.maps.places.Autocomplete (warning logged in console). Google recommends migrating to PlaceAutocompleteElement. Functional for now but should be planned.

haversineKm returns 0 when lat/lng missing — backend receives distance_km=0 and computes a base-fare-only price. If user types address without selecting from autocomplete, no warning is shown; consider validating that lat/lng exist before allowing Step 2 to proceed (currently any typed text is accepted).
No loading skeleton/spinner while accessAPI.match runs between Step 2 → Step 3 transition; user sees a brief blank list. Minor UX polish.
test_credentials: paul.vendeur@example.com / Test1234! (login endpoint /api/auth/login, NOT /api/auth/login/email which returns 404)
seed_data_creation: Created one access booking via POST /api/access/bookings during the happy-path test (vehicle=access_pmr, pickup=12 Rue de Rivoli Paris, dropoff=20 Av. des Champs-Élysées Paris). No certified Access driver was matched (expected: no seeded certified drivers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 review items verified PASS on viewport 430x900 with paul.vendeur user. Wheelchair filter confirmed: when wheelchair_manual is selected, only access_pmr and access_van are returned by /api/access/match — access_standard is correctly filtered out. A11y toggles persist via localStorage keys 'a11y_large_text' and 'a11y_high_contrast'. Large-text scales root container fontSize from 16px to 18.4px (1.15rem). Google Places autocomplete works in this test env (real suggestions returned and lat/lng set on select). Booking POST returns category_name + fare_estimate + pickup/dropoff and the confirmation screen renders correctly with 'Recherche d'un chauffeur certifié…' badge (no certified driver matched, expected). Taxi Hub entry: from /taxi click 'Plus de services' to switch to grid view, then 'taxi-hub-access-entry' card navigates to /access.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Module functions as specified.
